newsitem.title: USA: IPC Information Systems names new CFO.
newsitem.headline: IPC Information Systems names new CFO.

text.p: IPC Information Systems Inc said on Tuesday it had hired Brian Reach as its chief financial officer, to succeed Greg Riedel, who left the post in late fall to pursue other career interests.

Reach will be responsible for the management of all accounting, tax and finance functions worldwide, as well as bank and investor relations, and will start in the post on May 19, the company said in a statement.
Most recently, Reach was chief financial officer at Celadon Group Inc. He also served as president of C.P. Rehab Corp, a wholly owned subsidiary of Prime Medical Services Inc, IPC said.

"We believe that Brian's experience with publicly listed companies, financial planning, international financial management, and strategic planning brings a much needed resource to IPC's management team," said Terry Clontz, president and chief executive of IPC.
IPC Information Systems Inc delivers integrated multimedia communications solutions to the financial trading industry.
